purpose: Shared block contract connecting APP.md manifests, generated UI, code execution, image generation, decks, and receipts.
thesis: A block is a manifestation unit: inspectable, rerunnable, editable, validated, and composable.

app.description: Customer-facing app or workflow declared by APP.md.

code.description: Executable code, query, transform, test, or prototype.

image.description: Generated visual artifact using the AtrisOS product-surface theme.

deck.description: Narrative presentation composed from slides, images, code demos, and app surfaces.

receipt.description: Proof block for generation, execution, validation, and final artifact lineage.

composition.rule: No generated artifact should be orphaned; every artifact belongs to a block with inputs and outputs.
